h1: Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok — The Closest Full-Service 4-Star to Rajamangala National Stadium, 1.6 km Away
intro: If you are attending a concert or sporting event at Rajamangala National Stadium — Thailand's largest stadium, home to massive international concerts on Ramkhamhaeng Road — and want a proper 4-star hotel without paying premium Bangkok prices, Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok is the most practical option. It sits at 33 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 32, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, just 1.6 km from the stadium — roughly 7 minutes by taxi or Grab. The property has 168 rooms, an outdoor pool, spa, fitness centre, restaurant serving buffet breakfast, free parking and free Wi-Fi. Rooms start from approximately THB 900/night for a Standard room, rising to around THB 1,400 for a Family Room. Score is 7.9 from 1,453 reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: The single strongest argument for booking Livotel Hua Mak is geography: at 1.6 km from Rajamangala National Stadium, it sits closer than any comparable 4-star property in this price bracket. When a major international act fills all 50,000 seats and 50,000 people try to book Grab simultaneously after the encore, being seven minutes away by car matters enormously. Guests who attend concerts here consistently mention this as the key reason they chose the hotel.

Rooms are available in five configurations: Standard Double, Standard Twin, Deluxe Double, Deluxe Twin and Family Room — running from 23 to 27 square metres. Every room includes a private balcony, refrigerator, flat-screen LED TV, kettle, hairdryer and en-suite bathroom with hot water. The Deluxe category adds a slightly more spacious layout and tends to be on higher floors. Guest reviews across platforms consistently describe the rooms as clean, adequately sized for the price, and quiet enough given the residential soi setting.

The hotel's facilities are more complete than many budget-leaning 4-stars in Bangkok. The outdoor pool is open 07:00–20:00, the fitness centre has treadmills, elliptical machines and exercise bikes (open 08:00–20:00), and there is an on-site spa. The restaurant seats 200 guests and serves a mixed buffet breakfast — Thai, Chinese and Western options from 07:00 to 09:30. A meeting room accommodates up to 100 delegates, which makes this a sensible choice for group trips tied to stadium events. Free parking is plentiful and consistently praised by guests who drove in.
"Spacious room, clean, every room has a balcony — pool and gym are genuinely usable. Grab to Rajamangala was 7 minutes. For a 4-star at this price, hard to fault the value."

The honest picture from real guest reviews is more mixed on quality control. A meaningful number of reviews on both Booking.com and Trip.com flag inconsistent housekeeping standards: while most rooms are fine, some guests encountered blocked bathroom drains, musty odours, ants, or cockroaches — issues reported more often in lower-floor rooms. Sound insulation is thin, with wall noise from neighbouring rooms audible on busy nights. Breakfast quality gets a divided verdict: some guests find the buffet decent value, others note the menu repeats daily and feels rushed in quality. These are the trade-offs that explain the gap between Agoda's 8.2 and Booking.com's 6.9.

On transport: the hotel is in Soi Ramkhamhaeng 32, a residential lane off the main Ramkhamhaeng Road. It is not within easy walking distance of any BTS or MRT station. The MRT Yellow Line (Hua Mak station) is approximately 1.4 km away — reachable by motorbike taxi or a short Grab. The Airport Rail Link at Hua Mak is 6.6 km away, requiring a Grab. For travellers arriving by car, the free parking is generous and a genuine perk; for those relying entirely on public transport, factor in the extra cost and time of connecting rides.

Overall, Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok earns its 7.9 score by delivering solid value for a 4-star: decent room size, working pool, spa and gym, and an unbeatable location for Rajamangala events. What it does not deliver is the consistent, polished service of a chain hotel in the same tier. If your priority is being close to the stadium without spending big-hotel rates, this is the right call — book a Deluxe on a high floor, request a room away from the lift corridor, and arrive with reasonable expectations rather than luxury ones.

honestSummary: Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok is the best-positioned 4-star option for anyone attending events at Rajamangala National Stadium — spacious rooms, a working pool, spa, gym and generous free parking at a genuinely affordable price. The trade-off is inconsistent housekeeping in some rooms and thinner service standards than a branded chain hotel would deliver.
honestChecks: If you expect every room to be freshly refurbished and spotless — some rooms show wear and the occasional maintenance issue. Ask for a high-floor Deluxe room, inspect the room on arrival and request a swap immediately if it falls short. Do not accept a ground-floor room without checking.

If you plan to rely entirely on public transport — the MRT Yellow Line (Hua Mak station) is 1.4 km away and the Airport Rail Link is 6.6 km away; neither is walkable. Budget for Grab rides on top of room costs. This hotel makes most sense for those driving themselves.

If you are a light sleeper — walls are thin and noise from adjacent rooms or the corridor carries. Request a room on a high floor away from the lift bank, and pack earplugs as a precaution on nights when the hotel is full.

tips.title: Book Grab before the show ends
tips.body: At 1.6 km, a Grab to or from Rajamangala costs roughly THB 35–60 and takes 7 minutes. After a big concert, demand surges fast — open the app 10–15 minutes before you leave the venue, or walk a block away from the main exit before requesting a ride.

tips.title: Request a high-floor room at check-in
tips.body: Reviews suggest lower-floor rooms are more prone to humidity and occasional pest issues. Ask for floor 3 or above and, if possible, inspect the room before accepting the key. A quick polite request at check-in usually works fine.

tips.title: Free parking — arrive by car for hassle-free stadium access
tips.body: The hotel's free in-compound parking is one of its best features for Rajamangala visitors. Drive in, park, Grab to the stadium and back — no scramble for road parking near the venue.

tips.title: Check whether breakfast is worth including
tips.body: The buffet runs 07:00–09:30 with Thai, Chinese and Western options. Reviews on quality are mixed — if you are only staying for a concert night and heading out early the next day, the room-only rate may be better value; plenty of local food stalls and cafes are within a short walk on Ramkhamhaeng Road.

faqTitle: FAQ — Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok

faq.q: How far is Livotel Hotel Hua Mak from Rajamangala National Stadium?
faq.a: The hotel is 1.6 km from Rajamangala National Stadium — approximately 7 minutes by car or Grab, costing roughly THB 35–60. If you do not mind the heat, it is also walkable in about 20 minutes on a straight route. It is the closest full-service 4-star hotel to the stadium in this price range.

faq.q: Is Livotel Hotel Hua Mak close to any BTS or MRT station?
faq.a: The MRT Yellow Line (Hua Mak station) is approximately 1.4 km away — reachable by motorbike taxi or a short Grab ride. The Airport Rail Link at Hua Mak is 6.6 km away, requiring a Grab. The hotel is not within walking distance of either, but free on-site parking makes it an excellent choice for guests arriving by car.

faq.q: What is the room price at Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok?
faq.a: Standard Double and Twin rooms start from approximately THB 900/night in the low season. Deluxe rooms run around THB 1,100 and Family Rooms around THB 1,400. Prices rise noticeably during major concerts at Rajamangala or on public holidays — book early if your visit coincides with a large event.

faq.q: Does Livotel Hotel Hua Mak have a pool and gym?
faq.a: Yes — there is an outdoor pool open from 07:00 to 20:00, a fitness centre with treadmills, elliptical machines and exercise bikes (08:00–20:00), and an on-site spa. Free parking is also available. For a 4-star hotel starting from THB 900, this is a strong facilities package.

faq.q: Who is Livotel Hotel Hua Mak Bangkok best for?
faq.a: It is best suited for concert-goers and sports fans attending events at Rajamangala National Stadium, especially those arriving by car who can take advantage of the free parking. It also works well for anyone who wants a 4-star hotel with a pool and gym in Bangkok without paying central-Bangkok rates — as long as expectations around service consistency are calibrated to the price point.
